column3: Close to the Hebrew; “he sent them into the hand of their transgression” is rendered “He has cast them away for their transgression.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the abode of your righteousness” is rendered “your rightful dwelling place.”
Close to the Hebrew; חָנֵף (“the godless”) is rendered “the hypocrite.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it sees a house of stones” is rendered “look for a place in the stones.”
NKJV capitalizes “His way,” taking it as God’s way; the Hebrew “its way” most naturally refers to the withering plant.
Close to the Hebrew; וְאֹהֶל (“tent”) is rendered “dwelling place.”
